nodes.label: RAPIDS cuGraph GPU Acceleration Engine
nodes.description: High-performance GPU-accelerated graph analytics library executing parallel Breadth-First Search, PageRank, and Louvain community detection on massively parallel CUDA kernels.

nodes.label: ScaNN Anisotropic Vector Quantization Index
nodes.description: Scalable Nearest Neighbors vector indexing algorithm using anisotropic vector quantization loss optimization for ultra-low latency cosine similarity retrieval.

nodes.label: W3C RDF-Star (RDF*) Data Model Extension
nodes.description: Extension to standard RDF allowing statements about statements (quoted triples), enabling property graph edge annotation capabilities within RDF triples.

nodes.label: Differential Privacy Laplace Noise Injection Protocol
nodes.description: Mathematical noise injection mechanism adding Laplace distributed random noise to numerical query outputs to guarantee epsilon-differential privacy.

nodes.label: Louvain Modularity Community Detection Algorithm
nodes.description: Multi-phase heuristic graph partition algorithm optimizing network modularity to identify dense cluster topologies and domain sub-graphs.
